name: Handotai India Pvt Ltd
capabilities: Distribution of semiconductor materials and equipment
india_angle: Handotai India is focused on indigenizing the semiconductor materials supply chain to reduce geopolitical risks.
summary: Handotai India Pvt Ltd is a deep-tech materials science company specializing in the supply and distribution of semiconductor materials and equipment. They offer a range of products including custom wafers and adhesive tapes, and serve various segments such as wafer fabs and OSAT companies. Their strategy includes indigenizing the semiconductor materials supply chain in India.
technical_expertise: Adhesive tape technology for semiconductor processes
